name: roofle
description: Single-user macOS transcription + LLM analyst app (monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @roofle/shared && npm run build -w @roofle/analyst && npm run build -w @roofle/transcriber && npm run build -w @roofle/ui && npm run build -w @roofle/app
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @roofle/app
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w @roofle/app
